propositions: fsck and compact-all scans visit archived tickets unnecessarily, making maintenance operations O(all tickets ever created) as stores grow; archived tickets should be excluded from default scoping.
archive operation does not fold tickets inline before writing ARCHIVED event, leaving unfolded events in archived tickets until a later compact-all sweep reaches them.
rebar archive must perform a terminal fold (threshold=0, horizon=0) inline before writing the ARCHIVED event to ensure archived tickets are completely converged.
fsck and compact-all must default to active-only visitation (using .archived marker + _is_net_archived confirmation, matching ticket list semantics) with --include-archived override for deep audits.
A reverted-archive ticket (stale marker without net-archived state) must still be visited by default; marker alone cannot decide archival status.
Legacy archived-but-unfolded tickets from pre-change builds must be folded by compact-all --include-archived runs, ensuring no tickets carry stranded unfolded events.
